status: P1 of docs/PU12_DEVELOPMENT.md: the five stations, the equipment's switching and the deployment drills. The ASPD-U's working controls (the ДХ keys, the DI marker) and the plotting drill come with P3. The R-111 and the R-407 are worked as sets (19 Oct 2026, docs/research/PU12_RADIOS_2026-10.md).
notes: Equipment and stations: docs/research/PU12_RESEARCH_2026-10.md (the ČSLA plan, csla_pu12_manual). The deployment drills' order and the long jobs' times are SAM3D estimates fitted under the published norm (full deployment without wire lines at most 18 min by day, ru_pu12_text); a manual with the drill would replace them. Control labels are known for the ФР block's РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ and scale switch, the R-123M's (r123m_training), the R-111's (r111_to fig. 4) and the R-407's (r407_photos, r407_plate); the others are descriptive.

stations.label: Battery commander
stations.source: ru_pu12_text (командир боевого расчёта), csla_pu12_manual (Pracoviště velitele baterie)
stations.notes: At the IT-45 tube with the ДХ keypad, the DI marker and the ФР block (rwd_mb3); beside the plotter at the desk: the ŠČK commander's panel, the RTK-1 radiotelephone concentrator, the IT-2 board, the R-123M of the battery net (FuG-4) and the R-407 (FuG-5) behind him (ČSLA plan items 16, 18, 22, 25, 36). Gives the launchers their targets by voice.

stations.label: Squad leader (No. 1)
stations.source: ru_pu12_text (командир отделения управления), csla_pu12_manual (Pracoviště velitele družstva a řidiče)
stations.notes: Front right: the KP-4, the GAK's control panel, the VO telescope, the IT-1 board, the DTP, an R-123M (FuG-1, the air-picture net), the PVS-2 box (ČSLA plan items 1-9). Orients the post.

stations.label: Operator-plotter (No. 2)
stations.source: ru_pu12_text (оператор-планшетист), rwd_mb3 ("Platz des Planzeichners" beside the tube; the tube's place, with the ФР block, is the commander's), shilka_narod (the IT-45 with the ДХ keypad and the ФР block)
stations.notes: Beside the commander at the IT-45 desk; plots on the air-situation board (ČSLA plan item 24) what the tube and the voice nets give. No switches of his own: the ФР block, the ДХ keypad and the DI marker are at the commander's place (items 15, 19, 20).

stations.label: Radiotelephone operator (No. 3)
stations.notes: Left rear at his table: an R-123M (FuG-2) and the R-111 (FuG-3), the RK-1 box, the PVS-1, and the power boards around him (ŠČR, VS-27, FP, RR-361A; ČSLA plan items 37-48, 51). Raises the mast (a ČSLA caption: the signalman extends the 16 m mast).

stations.label: Driver-electrician (No. 4)
stations.notes: Front left; the BTR-60PB's driving controls, the PVS-3 box (item 29) and the ŠČV input board (item 32). Runs the AB-1 generator set and the vehicle's power.
